citation: Kerelsky et al., "Maximized electron interactions at the magic angle in twisted bilayer graphene", Nature 572, 95 (2019); arXiv:1812.08776v2 ("Magic Angle Spectroscopy")
license: arXiv.org perpetual non-exclusive license; facts and numbers only
topic: Scanning tunnelling spectra on the AA sites of twisted bilayer graphene at 1.10° and 1.15° are taken while a back gate changes the carrier density.

facts.text: A gap of up to 7.5 meV (peak to peak) opens in the conduction vHs only when that peak reaches the Fermi level, which happens near half filling of the conduction moiré band (about 1.4 × 10^12 cm^-2); at other dopings the peak is not split.
At charge neutrality both vHs peaks are present and unsplit.
The gap is significantly larger than the activation energy of the resistance near the same filling in transport.
Tip-induced band bending was seen in earlier STM work only at large twist angles, where the density of states is small; extrapolated to these small angles it is negligible.

ask: Which interpretation of the 7.5 meV gap is consistent with all of these observations?

hypotheses.text: A many-body (correlation) gap: it opens only when the flat-band vHs is at the Fermi level, and it is the spectroscopic counterpart of the half-filling insulator, smaller in transport because of disorder averaging.
hypotheses.locator: p. 5: emergence only at the Fermi level is direct evidence of many-body character
hypotheses.reason: 与全部观测一致，即原文结论。

hypotheses.text: A single-particle band gap of the moiré bands, present whatever the filling.
hypotheses.reason: 单粒子带隙与填充无关，应在电中性时也存在，但只有 vHs 到达费米能时才出现。

hypotheses.text: An artefact of band bending induced by the STM tip.
hypotheses.reason: 针尖诱导的能带弯曲只在大转角、态密度小时明显，在这些小转角可忽略。

hypotheses.text: The same gap that transport measures, with the same size, so transport fully captures it.
hypotheses.locator: p. 5: STM gap bigger than the transport activation energy
hypotheses.reason: STM 能隙明显大于输运激活能（原文归因于输运中的无序平均）。
